newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: S&P assigns AA rating to Australia's WB Trust.
newsitem.headline: S&P assigns AA rating to Australia's WB Trust.

text.p: Standard and Poor's Corp said on Monday it has assigned its AA rating to WB Trust's A$50 million of class-A senior notes.
The assets of WB Trust comprise fixed and floating rate amortising loans secured by first registered mortgages over property located throughout Queensland.
The loans had all been originated by Wide Bay Capricorn Building Society Ltd, which would be retained as the servicer of the mortgage loans, S&P said.
Fixed rate loans were swapped to a floating rate, using interest rate swaps entered into between the WB Trust and Societe Generale Australia Ltd.
S&P said represented the first public, stand-alone issue of long-term mortgage-backed pass-through securities by an Australian building society to be rated by Standard and Poor's.
